summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 reduced the target acquisition from 73.65% to 63.72% of JPMC shares, with a minimum threshold lowered from 40.16% to 30.23%. The bidders entered into agreements with major shareholders to not tender, and arranged for HTIO to acquire 1,452,100 shares (8.69%) as treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Offer Terms in Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of JPMC (Securities Code: 3276) by Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2
translation_en_brief: On September 14, 2026, Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 announced changes to the terms of their public tender offer for JPMC ordinary shares, which commenced on August 4, 2026. The bidders reduced the target acquisition volume from 12,303,225 shares (73.65% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) to 10,644,725 shares (63.72%), and lowered the minimum threshold from 6,707,800 shares (40.16%) to 5,049,300 shares (30.23%). The bidders entered into agreements with major shareholders, including the Kotsushin KK investment partnership, UH Partners 2 investment partnership, and Kotsushin Co., Ltd. (collectively holding 1,658,500 shares or 9.93%), to not tender their shares in the offer. Additionally, Kotsushin KK and UH Partners 2 agreed to distribute 1,452,100 shares (8.69%) to HTIO as a distribution in kind, and HTIO agreed to have JPMC acquire those shares as treasury stock. The bidders also obtained commitments from these shareholders to vote in favor of a share consolidation under the Companies Act Article 180, to be implemented following completion of the tender offer, and to abolish the par value of shares following the consolidation.
